title: Hilbert-Schmidt stability of direct products of countable stable groups when one factor has Kazhdan property (T)
author: Mikael De La Salle
work: Spectral gap and stability for groups and non-local games
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique—Mathématiques 12 (2025), 1417–1444; DOI 10.5802/jep.314; published 2025-09-19
difficulty_reason: The argument converts an almost representation into a representation in the commutant using property (T) and a quantitative spectral-gap estimate on the conjugation representation. It then rounds conditional expectations to unitaries and controls the defect under convolution before applying stability of the second factor; the finite von Neumann algebra and flexible-dilation steps are retained. These operator-algebraic compatibility and quantitative error-propagation obligations go beyond ordinary doctoral qualifying-exam representation theory.
